singapore.title: Stand on either side of escalators? Commuters reluctant to ditch 'keep left' habit in SMRT trial
singapore.summary: CNA's observations at City Hall MRT station found that commuters who walked up the steps on the right took about 20 seconds to complete the ride, compared with 30 seconds for those who stood still on the left.

singapore.title: Man arrested after alleged assault in River Valley, car overturns following police chase
singapore.summary: The suspect's car overturned at the junction of Race Course Road and Birch Road after a collision with another vehicle.

singapore.title: Sheila Sim on her runway return at Chanel in Sydney: ‘I represent women who have forgotten to love themselves’

singapore.title: After years of robust growth, a tough 2027 ahead for Singapore banks: Analysts

singapore.title: Singapore has plenty of shopping malls. But do they all feel the same?
singapore.summary: Veteran interior designer Mike Lim believes malls need to rethink their role as places for shopping, gathering and socialising. His projects in Kuala Lumpur offer a glimpse of what is possible.

singapore.title: Singaporean Ashley Tan dropped from CEO role by US-based non-profit FHI 360
singapore.summary: FHI 360's website had Mr Tan, 39, listed as the organisation's CEO on Nov 4. Checks by CNA on Nov 6 show that he has been replaced by Ms Deborah Kennedy-Iraheta as interim CEO.
